## Context

What has to be decided, and why it cannot be left as it is. What happens if nobody decides.

## Options

For each option, what it is and what it costs or risks.

1. **Option A**: ...
2. **Option B**: ...

## Recommendation

The option you would take and the reason, or "no preference" and what would settle it.

## Done when

The decision is recorded where it will be found: the text of a requirement in the specification, an
[ADR](https://github.com/yp44/powerj/tree/main/docs/adr), or a line in the documentation. If the decision is to do the work, the issue for the work
is linked here.

## References

Links: related issues, the review (`docs/REVUE-ARCHITECTURE.md`), the CHANGELOG.
